mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may potentiate anticoagulant effects through platelet inhibition and potential inhibition of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors, increasing bleeding risk when combined with rivaroxaban.
action: Monitor patients for signs of bleeding; counsel on consistent turmeric use and report any unusual bruising, bleeding, or blood in stool/urine; consider reducing turmeric supplementation or increasing monitoring frequency.
